purpose: Role-specific production plan for replacing quarantined THC education graphics with higher-quality reference imagery and diagrams.

plant-biology: Photorealistic whole cannabis plant with clearly visible roots, stem, nodes, leaves, inflorescences and labeled anatomical regions.
Macro botanical reference showing blade, petiole, veins, margin and stomatal surface context.
High-detail root architecture with crown, lateral roots, fine roots and rhizosphere context.
Macro flowering reference with bract, stigma, sugar leaf and glandular trichome callouts.
lifecycle-propagation: Seed, germination, seedling, vegetative growth, transition and reproductive development shown as one clean photographic sequence.
Imbibition through radicle emergence, shoot emergence and normal seedling establishment.
Cutting preparation, callus/root initiation, early root growth and acclimation.
Root-ball, container transition and early post-transplant recovery reference.
environment-vpd: Leaf-level temperature, RH, airflow and vapor exchange visual tied to room environment.
Diagram contrasting air-temperature-only assumptions with measured leaf-temperature VPD.
Canopy microclimate cross-section showing when surface condensation risk develops.
Room map showing representative temperature/RH sensor positions and common bad placements.
lighting: Photorealistic indoor canopy with fixture, measurement plane and visible PPFD grid concept.
Photoperiod plus PPFD concept showing how DLI accumulates across a day.
Reference set showing bleaching, edge stress, tacoing and non-light look-alikes.
water-root-zone: Container cross-section showing irrigation, pore water, air space, roots and drainage.
Time-series diagram connecting irrigation event, substrate water content and next irrigation.
Comparison of input, runoff and representative root-zone measurements.
Healthy vs oxygen-limited root-zone reference with environmental context.
nutrition-media: Root uptake to xylem, leaf demand and media chemistry in one systems visual.
Macronutrients, secondary nutrients and micronutrients with biological functions.
Mechanism-first pH/precipitation/chelation reference without one universal target band.
Deficiency-like symptoms compared against salinity, root impairment, pH and environment look-alikes.
training-canopy: Before/after plant architecture showing branch positioning and canopy distribution.
Bend radius, tie placement, stem expansion and damage warning signs.
SCROG support geometry, branch routing and service access.
Interior airflow, boundary layer and stagnant microclimate reference.
plant-health-ipm: Representative scouting route with inspection points, sticky cards and repeated counts.
Hemp russet mite, broad mite, aphid and common look-alike evidence at appropriate magnification.
Side-by-side disease evidence and favorable microclimate reference.
Observed pattern, supporting evidence, conflicting evidence and next confirmation step.
harvest-postharvest: Multiple-signal harvest assessment using whole plant, representative flowers and magnified trichomes.
Clear/cloudy/amber gland heads with magnification, lighting and sampling cautions.
Temperature, RH, air exchange, gentle circulation, spacing and room load.
Harvest batch through drying position, sampling, storage and records.
genetics-breeding: Pedigree/lineage visualization tied to generation, selection and population notes.
Same genotype concept under different environments plus within-population phenotype variation.
Male, female and intersex reproductive structures shown as botanical references.
Plant ID, phenotype observations, traits, photos and selection decision workflow.
outdoor-cultivation: Sun path, wind exposure, drainage, access and visibility shown on one site reference.
Protected-to-outdoor transition with increasing light/wind exposure.
Canopy wetting, airflow, flower density and drying conditions.
Slope, shade, reflective surfaces, wind shelter and low-spot humidity.
evidence-measurement: Photo, measurement, context, alternative hypothesis and monitored decision workflow.
Instrument, calibration, sampling, timing, units and interpretation.
Fixed camera angle, scale reference, lighting, plant orientation and timestamp.
Plant ID, event, measurement, image, intervention and outcome chain.
